notes: Upgraded from reproduced to verified (exact: true, we* + @mizopl, 2026-11-16, zero floating-point operations) via verify_challenge/cert_t5_m2_to_m5_exact.py, which certifies chi(|T5>^2) >= 5 over Hadamard-certified F_P (P = 1,000,000,021 > 5^10) and verifies (<0| (x) I)|T5>^(k+1) = 5^(-1/2)|T5>^k symbolically (note bounds/T5-m3-lower-6.json is attested on main). Prior reproduced record (verify_challenge/cert_t5_m2_rank4.py): chi(psi (x) phi) >= chi(psi) when phi has a nonzero computational amplitude, applied 1 time(s) to chi(T5^2) >= 5 (Lean: stabRankP_powVecP_mono in lean_proofs/LeanProofs/Stabilizer/SliceP.lean); every amplitude of |T5> is nonzero. The certificate is the m=2 rank-4 exclusion, which prints this line after certifying chi(T5^2) >= 5. Puts the cell at 5 <= chi(T5^3) <= 15 (bounds/T5-m3-upper-15.json), the first lower bound on the board for this cell. Whether chi(T5^3) < 15 is open: no Z-type sector route exists at m = 3 (docs/notes/t5q_m2_rank5_exclusion.md, section 8).
